simple.label: Simple
simple.description: Only a navigation bar over the page, and room for any sections. For a page you or Kaity build section by section. Not for a site that wants the same footer or side menu on every page.

basic.label: Basic
basic.description: A navigation bar, the page, and a footer, with a side menu beside the page if you want one (it can be left out). For most pages of most sites. Not for a page that needs a title, a menu and notes around it on every page.
basic.layout:
nav[role=header] side[role=nav] body[role=main] V@main{1:3 maxw=1320} footer[role=footer #tone-dark] H3@page
rule r1 below=800 flip main

full.label: Full
full.description: A navigation bar, a page title shared by every page, a side menu, the page, an aside with key facts, and a footer; the side menu and the aside can be left out. For sites with many pages: guides, documentation, an organisation's pages. Not for a one-page site.
full.layout:
nav[role=header] banner side[role=nav] body[role=main] aside[role=aside] V3@main{1:3:1 maxw=1440} footer[role=footer #tone-dark] H4@page
rule r1 below=1000 flip main
